summary.text: Brandon Lofton is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives from District 104, which he has represented since 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Brandon Lofton earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 2001 and a J.D. from New York University School of Law in 2004.
He succeeded Andy Dulin in the state House.
